ContactMessage.title: ContactMessage
ContactMessage.description: A private contact inquiry submitted through the portfolio contact page or terminal CLI, strictly visible only to the verified website owner.

read.description: Whether the website owner has marked the inquiry as read.

recipientEmail.description: Immutable owner email address that owns this inbox item.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the owner updated the read status.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Private portfolio contact messages collection. Anyone can create a valid inquiry, but ONLY the verified website owner (hussainmustafa2001@gmail.com) can read, list, update read status, or delete messages.
